en.bilal-muhammad: My father (rh) narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b. `Abdullah b. Abi Khalaf narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Abi’l Khattab narrated to us. He said: Ja`far b. Bashir al-Bajali narrated to me. He said: Hammad b. Waqid narrated to me from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as). He said:

Whoever says “May Allah be glorified in His praise, may Allah the Great be glorified (subhanallah wa bi hamdihi, subhanallah al-`athim)” thirty times will receive riches, evade poverty, and knock on the gate of Paradise.
